title: SMOK Nord Coils
description: The SMOK Nord replacement coils are a meticulously engineered series of coils designed to bring out the best performance from the SMOK Nord series devices. Their push-to-fit design makes swapping out your coils a breeze. And with three coil options to choose from, each tailored to a specific vaping style, Nord coils deliver a consistently satisfying experience whether you prefer rich DTL (Direct-to-Lung) clouds, a balanced RDL (Restricted Direct-to-Lung) vape, or an intensely flavoured MTL (Mouth-to-Lung) vape style. Designed for compatibility with the SMOK Nord Pod System, Nord AIO 19 & 22 kits, and the Trinity Alpha Kit, these coils feature premium build quality and cutting-edge technology, including mesh, standard and ceramic options for superior flavour and longevity. Details: SMOK Nord Coils offer a range of resistances and builds, each engineered to suit different vaping styles and preferences: 0.6ohm – Mesh Coil : Best at 20W-25W for DTL/RDL vaping; features a honeycomb mesh structure for faster heating and rich flavour production. 1.4ohm – Standard Coil : Best at 12W for MTL vaping; traditional single-coil design enhances airflow for a smooth draw and balanced vapour. 1.4ohm – Ceramic Coil : Best at 12W for MTL vaping; designed for exceptional longevity and enhanced flavour clarity. Each coil option ensures immaculate flavours, reliability, robust performance, and a versatile vaping experience to suit your preferences.
